A single anime-style character illustration, one continuous scene capturing a lightly comedic moment from an SCP Foundation incident report. A hint of eerie SCP Foundation atmosphere. If the Scene below does not specify a setting, default to a plain containment-facility interior (concrete corridors, fluorescent lights, institutional props) — but always follow whatever setting the Scene actually describes instead (a different indoor room, outdoors, a close-up on an object, etc.).

Characters appearing in this image (their default appearance — keep face, hair, and build exactly consistent with this at all times). If the Scene description below explicitly describes different clothing, protective gear, or accessories for this particular moment, the Scene always overrides this default clothing — draw what the Scene says they are wearing here, not the default outfit listed below:
- scp-100-1: A humanoid construct, roughly human-sized and proportioned, its body built from curved segments of dull galvanized-steel pipe joined at crude welded joints, its torso and limbs wound with coils of dark steel wire, its head and hands formed from flattened, riveted tin cans. Every metal surface is neutral grayscale only: charcoal, graphite, and pale gray. No copper, orange, brown, warm tint, or saturated color is permitted anywhere in the image. It has no facial features beyond a smooth blank aluminum plate for a face — no eyes, mouth, or nose. Default look (use this only if the Scene below does not specify different clothing/expression for this moment): No clothing (its metal body is its only surface); a calm, still posture between hand gestures.

Source context (not visible writing) — background facts this image must stay consistent with, but do not necessarily depict all of at once: "Sales made by SCP-100-1 are typically met with some degree of unfairness. SCP-100-1 has been known to intentionally use faulty scales and contaminate scrap piles with cheaper metals.". Depict the single moment described in the Scene below; that moment should be one instance of these facts, not a different or unrelated event. Do NOT render this sentence, or any text, as writing anywhere in the image.

Scene: Exactly two figures total. Camera directly behind a single researcher on the customer side: only a dark back-of-head silhouette, one shoulder, and one raised hand appear in the lower foreground; do not show this researcher as a full figure anywhere else. A long worn shop counter spans the full image width and divides the scene. Directly opposite, in the far background behind the counter, a single scrap-metal humanoid is alone and visible only from the waist up, quietly nudging the weight on a rusty hanging scale beside a pile of scrap. There are no other people, no other researchers, no humanoid figures, and no faces behind the counter besides the single construct's blank metal face. The two figures must not stand side by side. Strict black-and-white monochrome ink illustration: no color, no orange, no brown, and no warm tint.

Leave calm, uncluttered empty background space in the upper-left area of the image — this area will have text overlaid on top of it afterward by separate compositing, so keep faces, hands, and essential props outside it, and do not draw any bubble, box, frame, or outlined shape there yourself.
